seoTitle: Log Grep with Context: Regex Search with Before and After Lines
metaDescription: Search a log with a regex and show lines of context before and after each match, like grep -n -B -A. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: A grep with context for pasted logs or files: regex, before and after lines, invert, highlight and a match limit.
why:
Finding the error line is half the job. The lines before it usually tell you why. This tool shows them with line numbers, the way grep -n -C does.

Matches are marked with a colon and context with a dash. Overlapping context is merged. The output was compared with grep on a test file.
howTo: Paste the log or choose a file.
Enter a regex and set lines before and after.
Turn on ignore-case, invert or highlight if needed.

faq.q: Is the syntax grep or JavaScript?

faq.a: Hundreds of MB may work. For huge files use the large log file viewer.
A gap between two groups of context, as in grep.
No. Everything is processed in your browser and nothing is sent. Logs can hold IP addresses and tokens, so the page does not write them into the address bar.
